metaDescription: Create a Vedic birth chart and see the planetary positions, calculation settings, and ephemeris source behind it.
headline: Compute first.
intro: Discover your Vedic birth chart through precise astronomical calculations, with every planetary position and calculation source in view.
chartIntro: See how the diamond chart and placement table describe the same birth moment. This example uses a synthetic engine snapshot.
chartDiagram: North Indian chart of the synthetic sample, with planets listed by house
sampleMethod: Source: Swiss Ephemeris · Lahiri · Whole Sign · Mean Node
processTitle: From birth details to chart facts

steps.title: Save your birth details
steps.detail: Enter your birth date, local time, and location in a saved profile.

steps.title: Calculate the chart
steps.detail: Kundali calculates sidereal positions, Lagna, and whole-sign houses.

steps.title: Inspect the results
steps.detail: Compare the chart and placement table, then check the settings and ephemeris source.

method.title: Birth time
method.detail: We convert local birth time using the saved time zone and mark approximate times.

method.title: Ephemeris source
method.detail: Results identify Swiss Ephemeris, Moshier fallback, or a mix of both.

method.title: Conventions
method.detail: Lahiri and mean nodes are the defaults. You can change those settings. Houses use Whole Sign.

planned: Planned features include Dasha timelines, transit tracking, and source-cited interpretation.
disclaimer: Planetary positions are calculated astronomically. Traditional interpretations are offered for cultural exploration and reflection. Research has yet to establish that they can predict events.
